ratios.covenant_name: first-priority net senior secured leverage ratio
ratios.quote: The Revolving Credit Facility includes a maximum first-priority net senior secured leverage ratio financial maintenance covenant of 6.25 to 1.0. At September 30, 2026, the Company’s first-priority net senior secured leverage ratio was 1.5 to 1.0.

parsed.notes: The maintenance covenant applies only to the Revolving Credit Facility. The first lien net leverage ratio references that set pricing and commitment-fee step-downs are excluded. The Senior Notes indenture terms are also excluded. The company states it was in compliance as of September 30, 2026.
